description: Fill Level Indicator Visual is a custom Power BI visual that displays the fill level and capacity of tanks, rectangles, and circle containers. It provides a dynamic wave animation that makes monitoring more realistic and professional. Key features: - Visualize fill levels and capacity in real time - Supports tank, rectangle, and circle containers - Includes wave animation for a more natural look - Ideal for manufacturing, energy, and service industries - Simple and intuitive usage without extra configuration This visual helps organizations track utilization, monitor stock or liquid levels, and make better operational decisions directly in Power BI dashboards.
